name: Doodimo: Draw Music
subtitle: Doodle melodies & make beats
promotional_text: Turn a few lines into a musical loop. Explore colorful instruments, layer a beat, and share your creation as sound, video or a picture.
description:
Draw a line. Hear a melody. Doodimo turns your doodles into musical loops you can shape, replay and make your own. Start with a blank canvas or an original template, choose a colorful instrument, then press Play to hear your picture come to life.

MAKE MUSIC BY DRAWING
A moving cursor reads your marks from left to right. Higher marks create higher notes, and vertical lines can play several notes together. Erase, undo and redraw as your idea grows. You don't need to read sheet music to begin.

FIND YOUR SOUND
Explore 13 original synthesized instrument voices, from soft keys and bells to strings, guitar, bass and 8-bit sounds. Combine different voices in one drawing, adjust the tempo, and try 12 keys and 11 scales to change the mood.

BUILD A LITTLE GROOVE
Add bass, arpeggios and percussion with accompaniment controls. Adjust individual layer levels and mute parts while you explore a different mix.

MAKE IT LOOK LIKE YOU
Switch between smooth strokes and Pixel style. Choose colors and gradients for your canvas, or use a photo as a background. Try dark mode when you want a different workspace.

KEEP THE IDEA GOING
Save editable drawings on your device and return to them from your library. Export MIDI for compatible music tools, WAV audio, an MP4 of your drawing playing its music, or a PNG picture. Choose when to save or share an exported file.

CREATE OFFLINE
Drawing, playback and local saving work without an account or an internet connection. Your projects stay in the app until you choose to export or share them.

Pick a voice, make a mark, and see what it sounds like.
review_notes:
Doodimo is an offline drawing-to-music creation app. No sign-in or demo account is required.

1. On first launch, tap Start creating in the creation guide.
2. From Home, choose New drawing or an original template such as Woven ribbons. If editor tips appear, continue through them or skip them.
3. Draw on the canvas, then tap Play. The left-to-right cursor maps higher marks to higher notes. Choose another instrument to add strokes with another voice.
4. Use tempo, key/scale and accompaniment controls to change the loop. Erase and undo/redo are available.
5. Go Back, allow the local save to complete, then open Library > Drafts to reopen the drawing.
6. From the editor choose Export and create MIDI, WAV, MP4 or PNG. Completed files also appear under Library > Exports. Save/share use system interfaces. Keep the app in the foreground while exporting MP4; backgrounding cancels video export safely.
7. Background controls support colors/gradients and optional photo selection. Camera permission is requested only after choosing Camera; a physical device is needed for camera capture.

No advertisements, subscriptions, in-app purchases, server account or hosted community are implemented in this build.
